# Immutable pre-F1 text layout baseline

Captured from commit `d9192fc8e53cc035cb030f6de243b2a08f63cd37` before any F1 model feature edits. The capture verified that every recorded model source file matched that commit's Git blob before evaluating the inputs. `provenance.json` records those blob IDs, SHA-256 hashes, shipped font identities and the Node/ICU/Unicode versions used for capture.

**Never regenerate or update these expected data after F1.** There is deliberately no checked-in generation command. Future implementation changes must preserve the existing plain text/sticky outputs. The test pins the input and expected artifact hashes independently of the provenance file, then compares the entire serialized output byte for byte. Source hashes describe the capture; the test does not require future source code to remain unchanged.

`inputs.json` contains 100 deterministic complete elements with supplied IDs and indices. The 36-case matrix crosses Inter, IBM Plex Mono and Noto Sans JP with all three horizontal alignments, fixed/auto-size plain text and fixed/auto-size sticky notes. Sticky `autoSize: true` intentionally records the existing behavior, which still wraps within the sticky width. The remaining 64 cases cover empty and blank paragraphs, trailing newlines, consumed spaces/tabs, CRLF, space-plus-mark boundaries, combining marks, ZWJ/keycap emoji, regional-indicator flags, decomposed Hangul, Japanese/Latin transitions, kerning/ligatures and hard wrapping. Grapheme boundaries reflect the recorded platform Unicode tables; unsupported glyph coverage is a separate concern.

`expected.json` records, in order, each case's name, `textSize`, full `textLayout` (including every source/rendered UTF-16 caret entry), complete `deriveElementGeometry` output and complete `createElement` output. Serialization is `JSON.stringify(value, null, 2)` followed by one newline, without rounding numeric results or sorting object properties. Capture scripts were temporary and outside the repository. The existing immutable SQLite fixture is independent and remains unchanged.
